katatta.cp: neut. the doing of; the fact of having done.
katatta.p: [Kata+atta] (ti) CL=7 One who has the completed body and mind. Katatta(na) [kata+tta] (A) The fact of having done. (B) The fact of having acquired. A matter of cause that has been practiced. (C) As the state of development. (D) As the state of completion. See - Katanta.

C: katatta：[nt．] the doing of； the fact of having done．
P: Katatta，（nt．） [abstr．fr．kata，cp．Sk．kṛtatvaṁ] the doing of，performance of，only in Abl．katattā D．II，213； A．I，56； J．III，128； Dhs．431，654； SnA 356； DhA．III，154； IV，142．Used adverbially in meaning of “owing to，on account of” Miln．275； DhsA．262； Mhvs 3，40．--akatattā through non-performance of，in absence or in default of A．I．56； PvA．69，154．（Page 182）
CPD: 1 kata-tta , n. [ abstr. ], 1.a. the having done; (ii) the having carried through; b. the having cultivated, prac- ticed; c. the having held; 2.a. the having created; b. the having caused; 3. the having built; — 4. performed, com- pleted; — ifc. bahulī- ° (D ll 213, 16,20,23 ; S V 222, 8 ); — gramm. lit.: ( on the derivation of the word vāruṇī) Su- ra-Varuṇehi ekato hutvā ~ā, Sadd 795, 3 ; — 1.a. dvī- hi kāraṇehi attānaṃ garahati, ~ā ca akatattā ca, Nidd l 54, 13 foll.; 332, 9 ; 218, 25 ; Sumukhassa dosaṃ dassetvā accayapaṭiggahaṇassa ~ā pi tvaṃ amhā- kaṃ ācariyo va, Ja V 380, 17' ; catusu saccesu catun- naṃ kiccānaṃ ~ā aññaṃ uttariṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāma n' atthi, Mp lV 165, 4 ( ad A lV 255, 24 ); evaṃ akatāni pari' etāni imaṃ sammukhā vinayasaṅkhātaṃ vat- thuṃ virtā ~ā vatthuvipannāni honti, Sp 1396, 36 ; ca- tūhi maggehi soḷasannaṃ kiccānaṃ ~ā, Dhp-a lV 142, 12 ; pariṅñâdīnaṃ soḷasannaṃ kiccānaṃ ~ā ka- takicco, Th-a lll 15, 17 ≠ Ud-a 218, 20 ; — 1.b. satikara- ṇīyānañ ca dhammānaṃ ~ā sato, Nidd l 9, 28 (~ā ti katabhāvena; catunnaṃ maggānaṃ ~ā bhāvitattā ti attho, Nidd-a l 51, 29 ); satikaraṇīyānaṃ dhammā- naṃ ~ā sato, satipaṭipakkhānaṃ dhammānaṃ ~ā sato, 347, 10 ; dhammena vinayena satthusāsanena ~ā dhammo etesu atthi, Sp 879, 21 ; taṃ hi pamāṇaṃ atikkamitvā odissaka-anodissakadisāpharaṇavase- na vaḍḍhetvā ~ā appamāṇakan ti vuccati, Ps lll 450, 14 ; paṭiccasamuppādamukhena vipassanâbhini- vesassa ~ā, Ud-a 45, 16 ; — 1.e. thereh' eva ~ā ca the- rikā pavuccati, Sp 30, 14* ≠ Mhv lll 40 ( Geiger: "compiled"; Mhv-ṭ 151, 27 ); — 2.a. so tassa kammas- sa ~ā upacitattā ... sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ uppajja- ti, D lll 148, 3 ≠ Kv 467, 18 ; ~ā ācitattā ca Gaṅgā- bhāgīrasī' va 'yaṃ mahāsamuddā cattāro ghataṃ sampajjare mama, Ap 384, 1 = 436, 18 ; Kv 469, 7,9 ; 537, 27 foll.; yasmiṃ samaye kāmāvacarassa kusa- lassa kammassa ~ā upacitattā vipākaṃ, Dhs 431 (= katakāraṇā, As 262, 3 ) = 443 = Vibh 173, 25 - 297, 28 ; tass' eva lokuttarassa kusalassa jhānassa ~ā bhā- vitattā vipākaṃ, Dhs 535 = 543 = Vibh 205, 22 ; so evam anupubbena puññakammassa ~ā Anupubba- seṭṭhiputto nāma jāto, Dhp-a l 298, 10 ; lll 154, 26 ; 155, 1 ; As 289, 20,22 ; — 2.b. pabhaṅkaro ti sattaloka- saṅkhāralokesu ālokassa ~ā, Ja lll 128, 14' ; kathaṃ tāva na pakatatto rañño ghātāpitattā ruhiruppādas- sa ca ~ā ti ettha vadāmi, Sp 1277, 21 ; — 3. taṃ hi Ka- pilassa isino nivāsaṭṭhāne ~ā Kapilavatthū ti vut- taṃ, Ps ll 61, 12 ; taṃ kira calapaṅkaṃ nissāya ~ā o- lokentānaṃ calamānaṃ viya upaṭṭhāti, Mp lV 164, 13 ; ~ā Koḷanagaran ti ca vyagghapathe ~ā Vyag- ghapajjan ti cā ti dve nāmāni āropetvā agamāsi, Pj ll 356, 17 .

kaṭatta , n. [ abstr.; < 2 kaṭa + tta; cf . katatta of which ~ is a variant ] , the ( mere ) fact of having been created ( involuntarily ) ; cf. Abhidh-k-bh ad Abhidh-k lV 120; Trsl. vol. lll 242 foll.; ~ qualifies one of the eleven kinds of kamma, for which, v. s.v. kamma; ~ is only recorded in the abl. ~ā; for cpd.s with ~ā, v. infra; — exeg.: suttantikapariyāyena hi ekadāsa kammāni vibhattāni, seyyathîdaṃ: ... yag- garukaṃ, yabbahulaṃ, yadāsannaṃ, ~ā vā pana kammam +, Mp ll 210, 28 ; aññāṇavasena kataṃ ~ā vā pana kammaṃ nāma, 216, 10 ( " [ the proposition ] 'otherwise the kamma is due to the [ mere ] fact of being created' means that the kamma has been created out of ignorance" ); — gramm. lit.: ~ā kata- kāraṇā pavattaṃ rūpaṃ kaṭattārūpaṃ kammajarū- paṃ vuccati, Sadd 743, 8 ; — kammapaccayo ti kusa- lâkusalaṃ kammaṃ vipākānaṃ khandhānaṃ ~ā ca rūpānaṃ kammapaccayena paccayo, Tikap 5, 18 (~ā ca rūpānan ti kammassa ~ā uppannarūpānaṃ, Tikap-a 45, 33 ); 74, 22 ; 139, 29 ; 161, 30 ; Ss 102, 23 ; 106, 8 ; — ° -matta , n., the mere fact of having been created; ~aṃ, Maṇis ll 26, 23 , q.v. next.

kaṭatta.p: [Kaṭa+tta] (na) CL=7 One who has done (Kamma) is his deed.

[kaṭaṭṭhi ( q.v. ) + suffix ka], hip- bone; = the innominate bone, i.e., either of the two bones forming the sides of the pelvis; aṭṭhikāni apa- gatasambandhāni disāvidisāsu vikkhittāni aññena hatthaṭṭhikaṃ aññena pādaṭṭhikaṃ aññena jaṅghaṭ- ṭhikaṃ aññena ūraṭṭhikaṃ aññena ~aṃ ( v.ll. kaṭi-; kaṭha-) aññena piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ aññena sīsakaṭāhaṃ, so imam eva kāyaṃ upasaṃharati, D ll 296, 18 = M l 58, 30 = 89, 10 = lll 92, 8 ( with reading kaṭi-) = A lll 324, 17 ( with reading kaṭi-); ūruṭṭhikassa ~e patiṭṭhitaṭ- ṭhānaṃ suvaṇṇakārānaṃ aggijālanasalākābundisaṇ- ṭhānaṃ, Pj l 49, 27 .
